emails.subject: Your Bellevue doula practice is now featured on True Joy Birthing
emails.body:
Hi Expecting Joy team,

I'm Shelbi Kohler, a doula and founder of True Joy Birthing. I've admired your 5-star Bellevue practice (99 Google reviews since 2011) and just added you to our Bellevue birth-support page so Eastside families can find your birth doula, postpartum, lactation, and placenta services.

Thank you for the work you do supporting local parents through such a vulnerable time. Listings like yours genuinely help Bellevue families find care they can trust.

Please take a look when you can: https://truejoybirthing.com/bellevue-wa. If anything needs correcting, reply and I'll update it right away. If you'd rather not be listed, just say so and I'll remove it.

Warmly,
Shelbi Kohler
True Joy Birthing
104 E 600 S, #519, Heber City, UT 84032
